name: Chalet Belvedere
beschreibung: Chalet Belvedere is located in Kappl in the Paznauntal. The surroundings are characterized by the typical mountain landscape of Tirol. The holiday apartment has a kitchen, a living area, and separate bedrooms. The furnishings are designed for a longer stay. The atmosphere is quiet and understated. The accommodation is suitable for couples and families who prefer a self-determined holiday. The nearest shopping facilities and the valley station of the mountain railway can be reached by car.
